decision_reason: POST-001 demands RecordKind::StepSucceeded.id() == 33 with no drift. Risk_tags wire-format + persistence are field_sensitivity; default profile requires kani as the primary bounded-symbolic lane. The closed-set bijection over RecordKind::id() is a pure match with 28 arms; kani::any() over u16 proves the exact value at id 33 and the exclusivity of the bijection. Production binding: crate::records::RecordKind::id is the canonical encoder seam.

POST-002 demands the events.rs:406 OR-collapse be removed so StepSucceeded and SlotWrittenEvent project to distinct RecordKinds. Risk_tags persistence + wire-format + user-visible-behavior make this field_sensitivity; kani is the primary lane. The kani harness uses kani::any() for the run/seq/step/attempt field tuple and asserts record_kind() returns the canonical RecordKind for each variant. Production binding: crate::events::JournalEvent::record_kind (events.rs:401-429).

POST-003 demands is_known_record_kind(33) == true. Risk_tags parser-codec + wire-format + persistence classify this as rejection (admit/reject decision on a u16 id); default profile requires kani as the primary bounded-symbolic lane. The kani harness extends the existing check_journal_family_exhaustive at kani_record_kind.rs:265-289 to include 33, with kani::any() over u16 and kani::assert on the property. Production binding: crate::codec::validation::is_known_record_kind (validation.rs:23-25).

POST-004 demands validate_kind_family(MAGIC_JOURNAL_EVENT, 33) == Ok(()) and any other magic with 33 returns Err. Risk_tags classify as rejection; kani is the primary lane. The kani harness binds directly to crate::codec::validation::validate_kind_family (validation.rs:42-60) with kani::any() over u32 magic and u16 kind, asserting the family predicate. Production binding: crate::codec::validation::validate_kind_family (validation.rs:42-60).

POST-005 demands the parity gate accept envelope ids {12, 33} for StepSucceeded and id 12 only for SlotWrittenEvent. Risk_tags parser-codec + wire-format + migration + persistence classify as rejection; kani is the primary lane. The kani harness binds to crate::codec::EnforceKindParity::enforce_kind_parity (kind_parity.rs:50-64) and crate::codec::validate_journal_event_record_kind (mod.rs:97-111) with kani::any() for envelope id and kani::any_where for the JournalEvent shape, asserting the acceptance grid. The legacy tolerance for envelope id 12 is captured by LegacyEnvelopeBinding::Legacy{accepted_ids:&[12,33]}. Production binding: both impls are required to agree.

POST-007 demands SlotWrittenEvent + envelope id 33 returns Err(RecordKindPayloadMismatch { envelope_kind: 33, payload_kind: 12 }). Cross-bind rejection; same primary lane as POST-005. Kani harness adds a paired negative grid over the (envelope_id, payload_variant) cartesian product with kani::any() envelope id and kani::assert on the literal envelope_kind/payload_kind values. Production binding: crate::codec::EnforceKindParity (kind_parity.rs:50-64).

POST-006 demands decode_journal_event round-trips a canonical envelope-33 record and a legacy envelope-12 + StepSucceeded record. Risk_tags classify as rejection (round-trip admit/reject); kani is the primary lane. The kani harness binds to crate::codec::decode_journal_event (mod.rs:126-151) with kani::any() for run/seq/step/attempt and kani::assert for the round-trip equality. Legacy tolerance path: the harness synthesizes an envelope-12 + StepSucceeded payload pair and asserts decode produces the canonical value. Production binding: crate::codec::decode_journal_event is the only decode entry point per PRE-004.

POST-002 + INV-001 (one-to-one projection) demand randomized pressure on the events.rs:401-429 record_kind() function. Risk_tags wire-format + public-api + persistence classify as field_sensitivity; default profile requires proptest as the randomized-pressure companion to kani. Strategy: arb_step_succeeded_payload, arb_slot_written_payload, and a closed-shape arb_journal_event generator that reaches every variant; prop_assert_eq! on the projected RecordKind for each variant; anti-invariant asserts the post-fix projection rejects the pre-fix collapse. Production binding: crate::events::JournalEvent::record_kind.

POST-008 demands the durability matrix rows for step-closing primitives list RecordKind::StepSucceeded. Risk_tags classify as field_sensitivity; proptest is the primary lane (the data is a compile-time constant). The proptest generator enumerates each row's journal_events slice and asserts the substituted kind with prop_assert_eq!; anti-invariant asserts that the pre-fix SlotWritten entries are NOT in the post-fix rows. Production binding: crate::runtime::durability_matrix::DURABILITY_MATRIX.

POST-009 + INV-008 demand the recovery summary counters (steps_succeeded, slots_written) be variant-keyed and unchanged in semantics. Risk_tags classify as field_sensitivity; proptest is the primary lane. Strategy: arb_replay_sequence generating mixed envelope-id 12 + envelope-id 33 StepSucceeded events plus SlotWrittenEvent events; prop_assert_eq! on the post-replay counters; anti-invariant asserts that switching to id-keyed counting yields a different total. Production binding: crate::recovery::replay::summary::apply::apply.

INV-006 demands validate_schema_version(0) returns Err(MigrationRequired), validate_schema_version(1) returns Ok(()), and validate_schema_version(2) returns Err(UnsupportedSchemaVersion). Risk_tags classify as rejection; proptest is the primary lane (the function is a pure u16 -> Result match). Strategy: arb_version in 0..=u16::MAX with shrink; prop_assert_eq! on the discriminated error; anti-invariant asserts that the schema-pinning tests at tests.rs:3925 and tests.rs:4223 still pass under the new matrix. Production binding: crate::codec::validation::validate_schema_version (validation.rs:10-21).

flux-rs is not in the workspace dependency graph (vb-b8i8f: flux_rs crate absent; crates/vb_storage/src/codec/mod.rs:184-186 comments out pub mod flux_validation). The literal-sync obligation is enforced by proptest PO-QXJGX-007 (POST-011 verified via a #[test] that parses flux_validation.rs:14,33 and asserts 33 is in both literal sets). Re-enabling flux-rs requires the flux_rs dependency and the module uncomment; both are out of scope for this bead.
